description: This header file defines the interface for managing extension modules within a software project, specifically dealing with registration, deregistration, data management, and validation of extension modules that interact with the Wi-Fi layer. It includes function prototypes, data structures, and licensing information.

classes.name: wld_extMod_dataList_t
classes.description: A struct encapsulating a list of extension module data entries, intended for internal use to manage extension module data linked to core objects.

methods.name: wld_extMod_initDataList
methods.description: Initializes a data list used to store extension module data entries.

methods.name: wld_extMod_registerData
methods.description: Registers extension module-specific data within a given data list, associating it with an extension module ID and a delete handler.

methods.name: wld_extMod_getData
methods.description: Retrieves the registered extension module data corresponding to a given extension module ID.

methods.name: wld_extMod_unregisterData
methods.description: Unregisters extension module data associated with a specified extension module ID, without freeing the data itself.

methods.name: wld_extMod_cleanupDataList
methods.description: Cleans up all extension module data entries in the list for a core object, calling associated delete handlers.
